generic.name: Paracetamol
generic.indications: Fever, headache, toothache, earache, body ache, backache, dysmenorrhea, and post-vaccination fever.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 1-2 tablets (500mg-1000mg) every 4-6 hours as needed. Maximum 4g daily.
generic.side_effects: Rarely skin rash or allergic reactions. Prolonged excessive doses can cause liver impairment.
generic.precautions: Caution in patients with severe hepatic or renal disease. Do not exceed recommended dosage.

generic.name: Paracetamol + Caffeine
generic.indications: Fast relief from severe headache, migraine, dental pain, rheumatic pain, and fever with lethargy.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours. Maximum 8 tablets in 24 hours.
generic.side_effects: Palpitations, insomnia, nervousness due to caffeine in high doses.
generic.precautions: Avoid excessive intake of coffee or tea while taking this medication.

generic.name: Paracetamol (Extended Release)
generic.indications: Long-lasting pain relief for osteoarthritis, joint stiffness, chronic muscle ache.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 2 tablets every 8 hours swallowed whole. Maximum 6 tablets daily.
generic.side_effects: Mild gastric discomfort, rare cutaneous hypersensitivity.
generic.precautions: Do not crush or chew extended-release tablets.

generic.name: Paracetamol
generic.indications: Fever, cold & flu symptoms, tension headache, migraine, neuralgia, toothache, dysmenorrhea.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 1-2 tablets every 4 to 6 hours up to 4 times a day.
generic.side_effects: Generally very well tolerated. Rare hematological reactions.
generic.precautions: Care required in chronic alcoholics and patients with liver diseases.

generic.name: Paracetamol + Caffeine
generic.indications: Stronger fever, severe headache, migraine, toothache, muscle aches, sore throat.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours. Do not exceed 8 tablets daily.
generic.precautions: Limit caffeine-containing beverages during treatment.

generic.name: Paracetamol
generic.indications: Pediatric fever, post-immunization pyrexia, teething pain, cold symptoms.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Children: 10-15 mg/kg body weight per dose, every 4-6 hours.
generic.side_effects: Safe for children when taken at recommended dosages.
generic.precautions: Keep out of reach of children. Use measuring spoon.

generic.name: Omeprazole
generic.indications: Gastro-esophageal reflux disease (GERD), gastric & duodenal ulcers, Zollinger-Ellison syndrome.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 20 mg once daily before breakfast for 4-8 weeks.
generic.side_effects: Headache, diarrhea, nausea, flatulence, abdominal pain.
generic.precautions: Long-term PPI use may reduce vitamin B12 and magnesium absorption.

generic.name: Omeprazole
generic.indications: Severe refractory esophagitis, hypersecretory disorders, aggressive ulcer healing.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 40 mg once daily before meal.
generic.side_effects: Constipation, dizziness, skin rash, dry mouth.
generic.precautions: Rule out gastric malignancy prior to treatment initiation.

generic.name: Esomeprazole
generic.indications: Treatment of acid-related disorders, erosive esophagitis, NSAID-induced ulcer prevention.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 20-40 mg once daily at least 1 hour before meal.
generic.precautions: Patients on Clopidogrel should use alternative anti-acid therapy if advised.

generic.name: Esomeprazole
generic.indications: Healing of erosive esophagitis, maintenance of healed esophagitis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 40 mg once daily for 4 to 8 weeks.
generic.precautions: May increase risk of bone fractures with very high doses over multiple years.

generic.name: Esomeprazole
generic.indications: GERD, heartburn, peptic ulcer disease, H. pylori eradication alongside antibiotics.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 20 mg once daily 30 minutes before meal.
generic.precautions: Take capsules whole with water; do not crush beads.

generic.name: Pantoprazole
generic.indications: Acid reflux, gastric ulcer, duodenal ulcer, prevention of stress gastritis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 20-40 mg once daily before breakfast.
generic.precautions: Regular monitoring for patients with severe liver impairment.

generic.name: Pantoprazole
generic.indications: Moderate to severe reflux esophagitis, eradication of Helicobacter pylori.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 40 mg once daily in the morning before food.
generic.precautions: Enteric-coated tablet must not be split, crushed or chewed.

generic.name: Rabeprazole
generic.indications: Fast healing of active duodenal ulcers, active benign gastric ulcer, symptomatic erosive GERD.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 20 mg once daily in the morning before eating.
generic.precautions: Caution in patients with severe hepatic dysfunction.

generic.name: Omeprazole
generic.indications: Dyspepsia, heartburn, acid indigestion, peptic ulcers.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 20 mg once daily 30-60 minutes before breakfast.
generic.precautions: Take regularly at same time each day for best results.

generic.name: Montelukast
generic.indications: Prophylaxis and chronic treatment of bronchial asthma, relief of allergic rhinitis symptoms.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 10 mg once daily taken in the evening with or without food.
generic.side_effects: Upper respiratory infection, fever, headache, sore throat, abdominal pain.
generic.precautions: Not indicated for the treatment of acute asthmatic attacks.

generic.name: Montelukast
generic.indications: Childhood asthma maintenance, seasonal and perennial allergic rhinitis in children aged 6-14.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Pediatric (6-14 years): One 5 mg chewable tablet daily in the evening.
generic.precautions: Chewable tablets should be chewed before swallowing.

generic.name: Montelukast
generic.indications: Prevention of asthma symptoms, prevention of exercise-induced bronchoconstriction.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 10 mg daily in the evening. For exercise bronchospasm, take 2 hours before exercise.
generic.precautions: Notify doctor if neuropsychiatric changes (mood or behavior changes) occur.

generic.name: Fexofenadine
generic.indications: Relief of symptoms associated with seasonal allergic rhinitis (sneezing, runny nose, itchy throat), chronic urticaria.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 120 mg or 180 mg once daily with water.
generic.precautions: Do not take with fruit juice (apple, orange, grapefruit) as it reduces absorption.

generic.name: Fexofenadine
generic.indications: Severe chronic idiopathic urticaria, severe skin allergies, allergic rhinoconjunctivitis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 180 mg once daily with water.
generic.precautions: Dose adjustment recommended in patients with impaired renal function.

generic.name: Cetirizine
generic.indications: Perennial allergic rhinitis, seasonal pollinosis, urticaria, pruritus, allergic skin conditions.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 10 mg once daily in the evening.
generic.side_effects: Mild drowsiness, dry mouth, headache, fatigue.
generic.precautions: Avoid alcohol and operating heavy machinery if feeling drowsy.

generic.name: Ketotifen
generic.indications: Prophylactic treatment of bronchial asthma, allergic rhinitis, allergic conjunctivitis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 5 ml syrup (1 mg) twice daily with food.
generic.side_effects: Sedation, dry mouth, slight dizziness at beginning of treatment.
generic.precautions: Symptoms usually disappear spontaneously after a few days of therapy.

generic.name: Cefixime
generic.indications: Upper and lower respiratory tract infections, typhoid fever, urinary tract infections (UTI), otitis media.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 200 mg - 400 mg daily as single dose or divided in two doses for 7-14 days.
generic.side_effects: Diarrhea, loose stools, nausea, abdominal pain, flatulence.
generic.precautions: Check for hypersensitivity to cephalosporins or penicillins before use.

generic.name: Cefixime
generic.indications: Acute bronchitis, community-acquired pneumonia, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 400 mg once daily for 7-10 days.
generic.precautions: Complete full antibiotic course even if feeling better.

generic.name: Azithromycin
generic.indications: Respiratory tract infections, tonsillitis, pharyngitis, sinusitis, skin and soft tissue infections.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 500 mg once daily for 3 days or 500 mg on day 1 followed by 250 mg daily on days 2-5.
generic.precautions: Take at least 1 hour before or 2 hours after meals. Caution in hepatic impairment.

generic.name: Azithromycin
generic.indications: Bronchitis, pneumonia, sexually transmitted bacterial infections, severe acne.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 500 mg once daily for 3 consecutive days.
generic.side_effects: Mild loose stools, transient elevation in liver enzymes.
generic.precautions: Do not co-administer with antacids containing aluminum or magnesium.

generic.name: Ciprofloxacin
generic.indications: Urinary tract infections, bone and joint infections, infectious diarrhea, typhoid fever.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 500 mg every 12 hours for 7-14 days.
generic.side_effects: Nausea, diarrhea, tendon pain or swelling (tendinitis), dizziness.
generic.precautions: Drink plenty of water. Avoid direct exposure to strong sunlight.

generic.name: Metronidazole
generic.indications: Amoebiasis, giardiasis, trichomoniasis, bacterial vaginosis, dental infections.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 400 mg 3 times daily for 5-7 days.
generic.side_effects: Metallic taste in mouth, nausea, furrowed tongue, dark colored urine.
generic.precautions: Strictly avoid alcohol during therapy and for at least 48 hours after stopping.

generic.name: Metronidazole
generic.indications: Pediatric amoebic dysentery, giardiasis, anaerobic bacterial infections.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Children: 35-50 mg/kg/day divided in 3 doses for 7 days.
generic.precautions: Shake bottle well before each administration.

generic.name: Losartan Potassium
generic.indications: Management of hypertension, stroke risk reduction in hypertensive patients with left ventricular hypertrophy.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: Initially 50 mg once daily. Can be increased to 100 mg once daily.
generic.precautions: Contraindicated in pregnancy. Regular potassium level checking advised.

generic.name: Losartan Potassium
generic.indications: Starting dose for elderly patients or patients with volume depletion, diabetic nephropathy.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 25 mg once daily with or without meals.
generic.precautions: Monitor serum creatinine and blood pressure regularly.

generic.name: Amlodipine + Losartan
generic.indications: Hypertension not adequately controlled with monotherapy of amlodipine or losartan.
generic.dosage_and_administration: One tablet once daily in the morning.
generic.side_effects: Peripheral edema (ankle swelling), headache, facial flushing.
generic.precautions: Monitor blood pressure frequently when starting combination therapy.

generic.name: Metformin Hydrochloride
generic.indications: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, especially in overweight patients; polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS).
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 500 mg once or twice daily with or after meals. Maximum 2000 mg daily.
generic.side_effects: Gastrointestinal intolerance, metallic taste, nausea, flatulence.
generic.precautions: Take with meals to minimize stomach upset. Contraindicated in severe renal failure.

generic.name: Metformin Hydrochloride (Extended Release)
generic.indications: Better GI tolerated once-daily blood sugar control for Type 2 diabetes.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1 tablet once daily with evening meal.
generic.side_effects: Significantly fewer stomach problems than immediate-release metformin.
generic.precautions: Swallow whole; do not break, chew, or crush.

generic.name: Ketorolac Tromethamine
generic.indications: Short-term management of moderate to severe acute pain (post-operative, dental, renal colic).
generic.dosage_and_administration: 10 mg every 4-6 hours as needed. Maximum 40 mg daily. Duration max 5 days.
generic.side_effects: Peptic ulcer, GI bleeding, drowsiness, dizziness.
generic.precautions: Do not use for more than 5 consecutive days due to gastrointestinal and renal risks.

generic.name: Ketorolac Tromethamine
generic.indications: Severe acute surgical pain, trauma, acute orthopedic pain.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Administered intramuscularly or intravenously by healthcare provider.
generic.precautions: Hospital / clinical administration only. Monitor renal function.

generic.name: Naproxen Sodium
generic.indications: Pain and inflammation in osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, acute gout.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 250 mg to 500 mg twice daily with food.
generic.precautions: Co-prescribe PPI in patients vulnerable to gastric ulcers.

generic.name: Fluconazole
generic.indications: Candidiasis (oral, esophageal, vaginal), cryptococcal meningitis, dermatomycosis, ringworm.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Vaginal candidiasis: 150 mg single dose. Other fungal infections: 50-200 mg daily for 2-4 weeks.
generic.precautions: Check liver function during prolonged therapy.

generic.name: Fluconazole
generic.indications: Single-dose cure for vaginal thrush / yeast infection, recurrent fungal infection.
generic.dosage_and_administration: One 150 mg capsule swallowed whole once.
generic.precautions: Avoid during pregnancy unless clearly necessary.

generic.name: Carboxymethylcellulose
generic.indications: Relief of dry, irritated, burning eyes caused by wind, screen glare, heating or air conditioning.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Instill 1 to 2 drops in the affected eye(s) as needed.
generic.side_effects: Temporary blurred vision immediately upon application.
generic.precautions: Do not touch dropper tip to any surface to avoid contamination. Discard 1 month after opening.

generic.name: Paracetamol
generic.indications: Relief of headaches, tension headaches, toothache, muscle aches, and feverishness.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1-2 tablets swallowed with water every 4-6 hours.
generic.precautions: Do not use with other paracetamol-containing products.

generic.name: Amoxicillin + Clavulanic Acid
generic.indications: Bacterial sinusitis, otitis media, acute exacerbation of chronic bronchitis, community-acquired pneumonia.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 625 mg one tablet 2-3 times daily at start of a meal.
generic.precautions: Take at the start of a meal to reduce gastrointestinal upset. Contraindicated in penicillin allergy.

generic.name: Salbutamol
generic.indications: Quick relief of acute bronchospasm in asthma, chronic bronchitis, and emphysema.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1-2 puffs inhaled as needed for sudden shortness of breath. Maximum 8 puffs in 24 hours.
generic.side_effects: Fine tremor of hands, tachycardia, nervousness.
generic.precautions: If relief lasts less than 3 hours, seek urgent medical advice.

generic.name: Azithromycin
generic.indications: Mild to moderate bacterial infections of ears, lungs, throat, and reproductive tract.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 500 mg day 1, followed by 250 mg once daily days 2-5.
generic.precautions: Caution in patients with cardiac arrhythmia (QT prolongation).

generic.name: Atorvastatin
generic.indications: Hypercholesterolemia, prevention of cardiovascular disease, reducing myocardial infarction risk.
generic.dosage_and_administration: Adults: 10-20 mg once daily at any time of day, with or without food.
generic.side_effects: Muscle pain, weakness, joint pain, elevated liver enzymes.
generic.precautions: Report unexplained muscle tenderness immediately. Avoid large amounts of grapefruit juice.

generic.name: Amlodipine
generic.indications: Management of high blood pressure and chronic stable angina.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 5 mg once daily; can be titrated to 10 mg daily.
generic.side_effects: Swelling in ankles/feet, dizziness, tiredness, flushing.
generic.precautions: Monitor blood pressure regularly.

generic.name: Celecoxib
generic.indications: Osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, acute musculoskeletal pain.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 100-200 mg once or twice daily with food.
generic.precautions: Contraindicated after coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery.

generic.name: Esomeprazole
generic.indications: GERD, frequent heartburn relief, healing erosive esophagitis.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 20-40 mg once daily for 4-8 weeks.
generic.precautions: Swallow tablet whole with liquid. Do not chew or crush.

generic.name: Diclofenac Sodium
generic.indications: Inflammatory and degenerative forms of rheumatism, acute musculoskeletal trauma, low back pain.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 50 mg 2-3 times daily after food.
generic.precautions: Always take with food or milk to protect stomach.

generic.name: Vildagliptin + Metformin
generic.indications: Type 2 diabetes mellitus when metformin alone is insufficient.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1 tablet twice daily with morning and evening meals.
generic.precautions: Monitor renal and hepatic parameters periodically.

generic.name: Fexofenadine
generic.indications: Hay fever, pollen allergies, sneezing, itchy runny nose.
generic.dosage_and_administration: One 120 mg tablet once daily before meals.
generic.precautions: Non-drowsy formulation for active adults and daytime drivers.

generic.name: Clopidogrel
generic.indications: Prevention of blood clots in patients with prior myocardial infarction, ischemic stroke, or peripheral arterial disease.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 75 mg once daily with or without food.
generic.side_effects: Bruising, prolonged bleeding from cuts, hematoma.
generic.precautions: Discontinue 5-7 days before scheduled elective surgeries.

generic.name: Pantoprazole
generic.indications: Acid reflux, gastroesophageal reflux disease, duodenal ulcers.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 40 mg once daily in the morning before food.
generic.precautions: Do not chew or crush.

generic.name: Atorvastatin
generic.indications: Reduction of LDL cholesterol and triglyceride levels, coronary heart disease.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 10 mg once daily at bedtime.
generic.precautions: Periodic liver function tests recommended.

generic.name: Salbutamol
generic.indications: Bronchial asthma, exercise-induced asthma, COPD symptom relief.
generic.dosage_and_administration: 1-2 inhalations when breathlessness occurs.
generic.precautions: Rinse mouth with water after use.
